articles.title: CVE-2025-68395
articles.summary:
ARKETEAM Protectel modules PROTECTELMAJ and BDF  contain a note editor module vulnerable to Stored XSS. A low privileged attacker can inject arbitrary HTML and JS into notes, which will be rendered/executed when a user visits this module.
This issue has been fixed in: PROTECTELMAJ v6.5.19 and BDF v6.4.67

articles.title: CVE-2025-68394
articles.summary:

This issue has been fixed in: PROTECTELMAJ v6.5.19 and BDF v6.4.67
